communications.subject: SunCoast Travel — Booking Confirmation #SCT-4410
communications.body: Your hotel reservation is confirmed! Ocean View Room for 2 nights. Total: $312.00. Check-in details attached.

communications.timing: [4 months before the disputed charge, after checkout]
communications.subject: Thank you for staying with SunCoast Travel
communications.body: We hope you enjoyed your stay! Your folio for $312.00 will be charged to the card on file.

communications.timing: [2 days after the late charge appeared]
communications.subject: Why was I charged 4 months late?
communications.body: I see a charge of $312.00 on my current statement from your agency. My hotel stay was 4 months ago. Why is this being charged now?

communications.timing: [3 days after the late charge appeared]
communications.subject: RE: Why was I charged 4 months late?
communications.body: We apologize for the delay. Our payment processing system experienced a prolonged technical issue that delayed the submission of your transaction. The charge is for the hotel stay you completed. We understand this is inconvenient and regret the late billing.
